caption: The drawing depicts a heart-shaped object that appears to be an ornament or pouch, suspended by a braided loop at its top. The main body of the object is colored in a bright red, with a broad, wavy border outlined in grey and white beading. Inside the heart, there is a central motif showing a basket filled with blue and white flowers, and the basket is shaded with grey and green, resting on a patch of green at its base. Yellow and green floral or leaf-like decorations fill the left and right upper lobes of the heart. Around the edge of the heart, several tassels hang down—some are capped with green and yellow, while others are blue and white. The details on the object suggest beadwork or embroidery. The drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background with minimal decoration, and a small scale indicator is present at the bottom. Text in small print is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Pin Cushion
